module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic j,
    input  logic k,
    output logic Q
);

    // Positive-edge-triggered JK flip-flop
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({j, k})
            2'b00: Q <= Q;   // Hold (no change)
            2'b01: Q <= 1'b0; // Reset
            2'b10: Q <= 1'b1; // Set
            2'b11: Q <= ~Q;   // Toggle
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic in,
    input  logic [1:0] state,
    output logic [1:0] next_state,
    output logic out
);

always_comb
    case (state)
        2'b00: begin // State A
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // A -> B if in=1, else A
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b01: begin // State B
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // B -> B if in=1, else C
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b10: begin // State C
            next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // C -> D if in=1, else A
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b11: begin // State D
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // D -> B if in=1, else C
            out        = 1'b1;
        end
        default: begin
            next_state = 2'b00;
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
    endcase

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic in,
    input  logic [3:0] state,
    output logic [3:0] next_state,
    output logic out
);

    // State encoding: A=4'b0001 (bit0), B=4'b0010 (bit1), C=4'b0100 (bit2), D=4'b1000 (bit3)
    assign next_state[0] = (~in) & (state[0] | state[2]);   // A_next
    assign next_state[1] = in & ~state[2];                // B_next
    assign next_state[2] = ~in & (state[1] | state[3]);   // C_next
    assign next_state[3] = in & state[2];                 // D_next
    assign out = state[3];                                // Moore output (1 only in state D)

endmodule

Prob115_shift18.code:
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic load,
    input  logic ena,
    input  logic [1:0] amount,
    input  logic [63:0] data,
    output logic [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            // Synchronous load: replace shifter content with data
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            // Shift operation selected by 'amount'
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= q << 1;       // Shift left by 1 bit (logical, fill with 0)
                2'b01: q <= q << 8;       // Shift left by 8 bits (logical, fill with 0)
                2'b10: q <= q >>> 1;      // Arithmetic right shift by 1 bit (sign extension)
                2'b11: q <= q >>> 8;      // Arithmetic right shift by 8 bits (sign extension)
                default: q <= q;           // Fall-through (should not occur)
            endcase
        end
        // If load is low and ena is low, q holds its previous value (implicit hold)
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    output walk_left,
    output walk_right
);

// Internal state register: 0 = walking left, 1 = walking right
reg dir;

always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
        dir <= 1'b0;          // asynchronous reset: force walk left
    end else begin
        case ({bump_left, bump_right})
            2'b00: dir <= dir;      // no obstacle – maintain current direction
            2'b01: dir <= 1'b0;     // bumped on right – walk left
            2'b10: dir <= 1'b1;     // bumped on left  – walk right
            2'b11: dir <= ~dir;     // bumped on both sides – switch directions
        endcase
    end
end

// Moore output assignments (outputs depend only on the current state)
assign walk_left = ~dir;
assign walk_right = dir;

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  w,
    output z
);

    // State encoding (3 bits): A=000, B=001, C=010, D=011, E=100, F=101
    reg [2:0] state;
    reg [2:0] next_state;   // fixed: was wire, must be reg for assignment in always block

    // --- Next-state combinational logic ---
    always @(*) begin
        case ({state, w})
            4'b0000: next_state = 3'b001; // A, w=0 -> B
            4'b0001: next_state = 3'b000; // A, w=1 -> A
            4'b0010: next_state = 3'b010; // B, w=0 -> C
            4'b0011: next_state = 3'b011; // B, w=1 -> D
            4'b0100: next_state = 3'b100; // C, w=0 -> E
            4'b0101: next_state = 3'b011; // C, w=1 -> D
            4'b0110: next_state = 3'b101; // D, w=0 -> F
            4'b0111: next_state = 3'b000; // D, w=1 -> A
            4'b1000: next_state = 3'b100; // E, w=0 -> E
            4'b1001: next_state = 3'b011; // E, w=1 -> D
            4'b1010: next_state = 3'b010; // F, w=0 -> C
            4'b1011: next_state = 3'b011; // F, w=1 -> D
            default:  next_state = 3'b000; // unused states
        endcase
    end

    // --- Sequential logic (positive edge-triggered) ---
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset)
            state <= 3'b000; // asynchronous reset to state A
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // --- Output logic (Moore machine: z=1 for states E and F) ---
    assign z = (state == 3'b100) | (state == 3'b101);

endmodule

    output [3:0] q

begin

        4'b0000: q_int = b;   // c = 0  -> q = b
        4'b0001: q_int = e;   // c = 1  -> q = e

    endcase
end

assign q = q_int;

endmodule
